text:
maya: Quick heads-up — we need to schedule a focused design review for the Unified Client work (API + SDK auth + Console UX). Target 30m. I want to lock a slot and get a short pre-read checklist out.

sam: 👍 I'm owning the SDK auth section. morning PST preferred for me.

oliver: Morning PST also good. OOO Wed afternoon though.

jasmin: I can do Tue morning PST or Wed late-afternoon UTC. Can we do a quick poll?

maya: Poll: react :one: for Tue 10:00am PDT (Tue 17:00 UTC), :two: for Wed 4:00pm UTC (Wed 9:00am PDT).

maya: Pre-read checklist (please skim before the meeting) — quick items only:
```
- Read RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/432-unified-client-config
- Review PR diff: https://redwood.internal/prs/987 (focus on auth changes)
- Look at Console wireframes: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/ui-unified-client
- Prepare one short use-case and one open question each
- Confirm test/dev demo env works (step: `make demo-up && ./scripts/populate-demo --users=10`)
- Assigned reviewers: SDK = @sam, API = @oliver, Console = @jasmin
```

sam: I'll leave inline comments on the PR by EOD Mon. Planning to validate the auth token flow and error states.

ryan: Can SRE join for latency/ops concerns? want to check rollout/fallback plan.

maya: Yes pls — @ryan join. Also think about canary policy + fallback model variant we should call out in the agenda.

oliver: Ack — I'll add a short note in the PR about fallback variant mapping.

jasmin: If Tue wins I'll demo the Console flows + a quick demo user journey. Need a minute or two for wires.

calendar-bot: Tentative invite created: Tue 10:00am PDT / Tue 17:00 UTC — title: "Unified Client: API/SDK/Console design review" (will update after votes).

maya: One more ask — keep the meeting tight: 20m walkthrough, 10m decision/action items. I'll capture action items in the thread.

maya: If anyone can't make it, drop questions here or mark reviewer comments on the PR.

sam: reacting with :one:

oliver: reacting with :one: too

jasmin: reacting with :two: (slightly prefer Wed but ok Tue)

ryan: :one:

maya: Looks like Tue wins by reactions. I'll finalize the invite and add the agenda + pre-read links. Invite will include a tiny agenda: 1) goals & success metrics (2m), 2) SDK auth changes (6m), 3) API schema & fallbacks (6m), 4) Console demo & UX concerns (4m), 5) actions & owners (12m).

maya: Final invite sent. Please mark "Going" and add any pre-meeting notes in the PR or here. Thanks everyone!
